name: sbridge
description: 会话接力工作台：在 Codex / Pi / Claude Code 之间搬运本地会话

scripts.build:exe: esbuild src/server.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/app.cjs --log-level=error && node --experimental-sea-config sea-config.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');fs.copyFileSync(path.join(path.dirname(process.execPath),'node.exe'),'dist/sbridge.exe');console.log('copied node.exe')" && node scripts/prepare-node-modules.mjs --target win32 && npx postject dist/sbridge.exe NODE_SEA_BLOB dist/sea-prep.blob --sentinel-fuse NODE_SEA_FUSE_fce680ab2cc467b6e072b8b5df1996b2
scripts.build:exe:linux: esbuild src/server.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/app.cjs --log-level=error && node --experimental-sea-config sea-config.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync(process.execPath,'dist/sbridge');fs.chmodSync('dist/sbridge',0o755);console.log('copied node')" && node scripts/prepare-node-modules.mjs --target linux && npx postject dist/sbridge NODE_SEA_BLOB dist/sea-prep.blob --sentinel-fuse NODE_SEA_FUSE_fce680ab2cc467b6e072b8b5df1996b2 && chmod +x dist/sbridge
